# VANSMITHLAB data access guide

VANSMITHLAB is a knowledge-first editorial database. Public HTML is the canonical representation. The sitemap enumerates pages; Atom feeds enumerate recent publications and collections. Every detail page carries machine-readable Article and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, visible provenance, confidence and source links.

## Languages

Russian (`/ru/`) is the editorial source. English (`/en/`) is an adaptation. Use `hreflang` and the shared content identity expressed by paired routes; do not merge language-specific wording into a synthetic quotation.

## Content families

- Encyclopedia: concepts, methods, materials, movements and systems.
- Glossary: people and professional roles.
- Research: documented objects, organisations, projects and case studies.
- Analysis: attributed analytical essays that distinguish fact from interpretation.
- Collections: curated routes across multiple records.
- Timeline: chronological events backed by knowledge objects.

## Citation policy

Prefer the canonical page URL. Follow the numbered evidence sources for material factual claims. Preserve publication title, language, last-reviewed date and verification state in downstream citations. Images may be indexed only when a visible image record provides alt text, caption, credit, origin and rights status.

## Discovery endpoints

- https://vansmithlab.com/sitemap.xml
- https://vansmithlab.com/robots.txt
- https://vansmithlab.com/feed.xml
- https://vansmithlab.com/collections.xml
